summary.text: Nicole Sigurdson is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 19 in the November 3, 2026 general election, an open seat with no incumbent.
A community organizer, she said in a Ballotpedia survey that she has worked for five years as an organizer with SEIU 1199.

paragraphs.text: Nicole Sigurdson graduated from Lakewood High School and earned a bachelor's degree from The Ohio State University in 2016.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she grew up in the suburbs of Cleveland and lives in the Old Brooklyn neighborhood.
She said she has worked for the last five years as an organizer with SEIU 1199, representing healthcare and social service workers across northern Ohio.
Sigurdson advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

In her survey, she said she would stand with unions and protect collective bargaining rights, and she listed raising wages, workplace safety standards and addressing gender and racial pay gaps among her priorities.
